title: Keys to Communicate Speech Pathology - Videos
description:
Hi
I'm Nia, a Certified Practising Speech Pathologist in Tasmania, Australia, and a children's book author. 
I have a passion for supporting children's language, speech, and literacy development. 
My special interest area is Childhood Apraxia of Speech, a rare, 1 in 1000 speech disorder that is lifelong. 
Subscribe to my channel to learn about all things communication related for children!
You can find even more content (posts/reels) on my social media pages: 
Facebook - Keys to Communicate Speech Pathology 
Instagram - @keystocommunicatesp

You can purchase my resources via 
linktr.ee/keystocommunicatesp
